svg.title: Shared compaction worker pool across multiple SlateDB instances
svg.desc: Before: each database instance runs its own compaction thread pool, paying for idle capacity per database. After: a single shared worker pool services many database instances by polling each instance's .compactions file, letting compaction resources flow to whichever database has the heaviest backlog at any moment.
svg.text: each DB provisions its own threads
α and γ idle while β is overloaded
DB β backs up · can't borrow α's or γ's threads
Each one is its own island.
β gets 6 workers · γ gets 1 · α gets 0
pay for aggregate peak, not N × peak
